rows.en: Liberate Lunar City
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: 40 percent city damage
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Win with city damage 3 percent or less
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: We've received an urgent request for support from the United Space Force.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: Right now, in the government district of <pic(0)><cs(3)>Von Braun<ce()>, <mk(0,-37.5,6,1)><mk(25,-12.5,4,1,50)><mk(25,-62.5,0,1,100)><mk(50,-37.5,2,1,150)>Grados forces have holed up.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: They're wearing explosives and demanding the release of the prisoners the city holds.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: The citizens have been evacuated, but the whole city is in danger.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: According to the mayor, a certain amount of damage is unavoidable, but
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: if the damage exceeds acceptable limits, the city will give in to the enemy's demands.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(-37.5,37.5,1,0,50)><ar(0,1,0,150)>With UCE prestige at stake, we'll take out the enemy while keeping city damage minimal.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: I have already been informed of this matter.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: The United Space Force is part of the UCE too. I suppose its requests must be heard.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: But I'd like you to weigh the need for emergency missions from outside my headquarters.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Crushing Grados small fry... gains us nothing whatsoever.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Had you not worried about the damage around you, you could have finished in less time.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: There is no need to show any mercy to that lot in space.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Lately, every colony has been stepping up its defiance of us.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Do not forget that your priority is recovering the E2.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: So you're just a ragtag unit after all. It seems I was a fool to expect anything of you.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail
